content_md:
Another thing I recently built is an Obsidian plugin to resurface my past writing on paragraph level. It features three modes:

1) Pin Paragraphs: add a pin to a paragraph you want to find easily later

2) Loop Paragraphs: cyclical retrieval of starred paragraphs with adjustable cycle length - I use this for “this is interesting, but I dont yet know why” kind of thing

3) Review Paragraphs: resurface past writing from defined sources (Daily Notes and Readwise-synced Reading Notes for me), add Theme Links, copy into existing Drafts, or Pin / Star if needed

I will clean-up and share this one as well, probably before Christmas. If anyone is interested in giving this a try, this should certainly speed up things.
